docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
One hundred songs of the fifteenth-century weaver-poet of Banaras, in Tagore’s English translation, with Evelyn Underhill’s introduction.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Songs of Kabir · Kabir, 15th cent, Tagore, Rabindranath, 1861-1941, Underhill, Evelyn, 1875-1941 · 1915, 172 scanned pages. Published 1915; Rabindranath Tagore died 1941 and Evelyn Underhill 1941; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
